description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management center is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of a member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the member.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The type of the view.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts in your enterprise.

description.zh:
规则类型。 取值：
- predefine：预定义
- customize：自定义
description.en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

- predefine: predefined

- customize: custom

title.zh: 获取自定义规则可选威胁类型列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem describe-alert-type --rule-type customize --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
